method_input.plan_text:
Entities:
- Supplier A (resource): name = "Supplier A"; capacity = 80.
- E2 (audit): verified_capacity = 50.
- E3: required = 100; available = 80; coverage = 0.8; status = "PARTIAL".
- office wifi: name = "office wifi".
Links:
- Supplier A → E3 (supports).
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.
Rules:
- available of E3 = [capacity of Supplier A, counted only while Supplier A has an influencing link into E3; otherwise 0].
- available of E3 = [verified_capacity of E2, counted only while E2 has an influencing link into E3; otherwise 0] (applies only while E2 has an influencing link into E3).
- coverage of E3 = (available of E3 ÷ required of E3).
- status of E3 is "FULL" if (coverage of E3 ≥ 1); "INVALID" if (coverage of E3 ≤ 0); otherwise "PARTIAL".
